BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: We should ban New Year resolutions. People never keep them anyway so why bother? ASSISTANT:

We should not ban New Year resolutions. While it is true that people may not keep them on a regular basis, they are a great tool to have to remind us of our commitment to God's direction in our life.It is also encouraging to see the effort and engagement by our members. We should not waste the opportunity to equip our members to reflect on their experience and grow in their walk with Christ.
We should be encouraged to participate in a resolution process that emphasizes our commitment to Christ’s direction in our life.
